name: Birdshot
text: No pellet flies loose: everything in a 2.6 m wide lane a quarter longer than the range takes 40% of a full point-blank volley at once and is knocked down the lane.
vfx: pellets streak down the lane and a pale gold wash marks it on the sand for a moment
art_prompt: a shotgun shell with a long straight streak of tiny lead pellets flying out of it in a narrow lane
